verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents acknowledging incidents from a phone: a 'single tap' bulk acknowledge that stops the phone ringing (docs-19, docs-53), pressing 1 on a voice call (docs-11), and push notifications as an alert channel (docs-29). However, no evidence explicitly names a full mobile app, and resolving or escalating from mobile is not shown. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a native mobile app, mobile resolve and escalate/reassign actions, and independent hands-on corroboration of the mobile experience.
